source_quality.notes: text layer covers all 23 pages; the displayed formulas were checked on the raster until the view budget ran out

task_reconstruction: Build a three level indicator system for smart growth, weight it by entropy and by four experts, grade it with K-means, score Pittsburgh and Ningguo, and rescore both under a new plan and a larger population.

the background, the task chain and the flow chart

contributions.summary: a success degree written as a weighted sum of five second class indicators
four expert judgment matrices pooled into one weight vector
a grading standard taken from clustering ten cities into three
a forecast that combines a kernel regression with a weighted moving average

dependency_graph.relation: the scaled indicators are what the entropy sees
the quantified indicators join the matrix
the primary weights build the second class indicators
the pooled weights scale the five indicators
the index values are what gets clustered
the forecast indicators are rescored by the same index

assumptions.summary: government policy stays unchanged in the short term
the data source is actual and reliable
explosive change over the decades is neglected
expert scores are free of subjective factors

data_and_preprocessing.summary: 88 indicators collected, pittsburgh from a city data site and ningguo from a national bureau
gaps filled by the previous value, a neighbor average, a similar group, or interpolation
principal component analysis cuts the 88 indicators to 25
indicators split into cost, benefit and moderate before scaling

models.summary: three normalizations, one per indicator direction
a fuzzy score for the qualitative indicators
entropy weights from a correlation objective
four experts pooled and checked for consistency
the success degree as a weighted sum
three clusters over ten cities as the grading standard
a kernel regression of the indicator on the year
two population forms, one per city

verification.summary: consistency index and ratio for the judgment matrices
a grid search with the winning pair printed
the mean square error plotted against the two parameters

results_trace.summary: pittsburgh gains most from the land intensive rate
ningguo gains most from economic development

writing_logic.summary: the summary walks the five tasks in order
the task chain ends by pointing at the flow chart
each method is announced as essential before its formula
the weakness is conceded with the effort and the finite time

language_observations.summary: opens by calling the field a hot spot of most concern
glosses sprawl as a standing pancake
introduces the repair with to ameliorate this situation
concedes with although we have try our best

visualization_observations.summary: a flow chart shows the order of the five tasks
a diagram hangs five dimensions off a central smart growth node
a radar chart draws the pass line and the excellent line
the current plan and the proposed plan share one figure

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: taking the grading line from clustered cities rather than from a round number reads as earned
pairing an objective weight with a subjective one and saying so reads as balanced

weaknesses.summary: the normalization bounds disagree and the prose swaps city and index
the clustering objective is introduced as the goal of the PCA
the smaller-better case is footnoted as the smarter the better
the ningguo population form is unbounded

independent_extensions.summary: score a city by a weighted sum of second class indicators built from a reduced primary set
set the grading lines by clustering reference cities instead of choosing them

unresolved_questions: the normalization index runs to 25 in one formula and 23 in the next
the expert weights used to pool the four vectors are not printed
the ten cities behind the grading standard are not named
the kernel formula is cut off at the page boundary
the ningguo population form turns negative for large years
